companyAnnouncements: Local-first RAG: S3 and OpenSearch run on LocalStack Community; embeddings default to MiniLM and chat to Ollama.
Never send bedrock-runtime to LocalStack. Use real AWS only when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER or LLM_PROVIDER is bedrock.
Query and ingest must share the same embedding model and dimension. Changing either requires a full re-ingest.
Do not add LangChain or a second config system. Extend the existing provider ABCs in src/embeddings.py and src/llm.py.
